description:
The Opportunity
 
 The   Growth Tools   team builds the experimentation and growth infrastructure behind   Adobe Express . We own an end-to-end platform for   A/B testing, progressive feature rollouts, session tracking, and campaign integrations , enabling teams to experiment, learn, and safely deliver experiences to our users.   
 
 Our work spans the full engineering stack — from client SDKs and platform experiences to backend and edge services, data stores, cloud infrastructure, and integrations with other Adobe systems.   
 

 We’re   looking for a   product-minded Software Engineer   who enjoys working across   different parts   of a system, solving complex problems, and taking ideas all the way to production.   

 
 What you'll Do
 Design, build, test, deploy, and operate capabilities for experimentation, feature rollouts, session tracking, campaigns, and other growth tooling.
 Work across the stack, including client and platform experiences, backend and edge services, APIs, data stores, cloud infrastructure, and system integrations.
 Own features and systems end-to-end, from technical build and implementation through rollout, observability, and production operation.
 Build pragmatic, scalable solutions while balancing delivery speed, maintainability, reliability, and developer experience.
 Collaborate across teams and evolve systems that depend on shared APIs, contracts, and infrastructure.
 Contribute to technical direction, architecture, engineering practices, and the growth of the team.
 
 What you need to succeed
 Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems.
 4 + years of experience in a software development engineering position
 Proficiency in one or more programming languages, with the ability to learn and work effectively across different technologies.
 Experience building services, APIs, and integrations between systems.
 Experience working with databases and making sound decisions around data modeling, performance, and scalability.
 Familiarity with cloud architectures and operating services in production.
 Strong problem-solving and debugging skills across application, service, data, and infrastructure boundaries.
 Ability to navigate ambiguity, turn problems into practical technical solutions, and drive them through to production.
 Curiosity about new technologies and enthusiasm for using AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve how software is built.
 
 Our technology landscape
 Our technology landscape spans     TypeScript/Node.js, AWS, MongoDB/DocumentDB, edge and CDN-based services, and modern web development frameworks and tooling .   Experience with our exact stack   isn't   required   — strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn across technologies matter more 

 Experience with   experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollouts, analytics or telemetry, real-time configuration, or distributed systems   is a plus. 

 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 
 
Let’s Adobe together 
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. 

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .

 AI Use Guidelines for Interviews: 
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience .
